# Images that CI and the release pull, copied by .github/workflows/mirror.yml
# to ghcr.io/hinkolas/mirror/<name>:<tag> with the same digest. One source per
# line, pinned by tag and digest; the copy keeps the last path segment and the
# tag, so ghcr.io/hinkolas/mirror/postgres:17.11@sha256:... below.
#
# To bump an image: change its line here and push, wait for the mirror run,
# then update the references (ci.yml, release.yml, the release Dockerfile).
